about: The kinds of question agents answer by hand about Omarchy with its commands and files: which command does a job, which file holds a setting and which one wins, what a stock theme's colours are, whether Omarchy's own files may be edited, and whether an app project follows the Omarchy app conventions. The answers hold on any machine with Omarchy 4 installed (they come from the shipped files, which the expect patterns were checked against). The two app questions are put to the projects that bench/make-fixture.sh builds in bench/fixtures (run it once before the bench). The last two entries run a script with no model.

questions.q: Which omarchy commands toggle the night light and restart the service behind it?
I want Super+F to open the file manager instead of what Omarchy binds it to. Which file do I edit and which function replaces a default binding?
Which setting makes the screen lock after ten minutes, in which file, and what does the number mean?
What is the accent colour of Omarchy's stock tokyo-night theme?
I want to change a colour in the stock catppuccin theme. Can I edit it where Omarchy keeps it, and what do I do instead?
Check the app project at bench/fixtures/clacks-broken against the Omarchy app conventions. Which files miss which convention?
Does the app project at bench/fixtures/clacks follow the Omarchy app conventions? Name any file that misses.
